source_format: PostgreSQL custom archive 1.16, produced by PostgreSQL 18.6
warnings: Real faculty names and employment statuses are restored from the source; the previous local faculty IDs are deliberately preserved so assignments and advisers keep their links.

Three faculty names (local IDs 17, 98, 99) are already placeholder labels in the original dump. They are retained verbatim and flagged for review, not replaced with invented names. There are 34 subjects without curriculum/year membership.
Working hours are extracted from faculty.profile.worktime, including explicit Saturday availability. The old standalone faculty_worktime table is empty but the JSON profiles are not.

Four faculty with active source teaching-window considerations are flagged for priority placement. Detailed preferences remain informational notes; exact work-time windows are the hard limits. Source day 0 is labelled unspecified, not guessed.

Major/minor is not an explicit source column: the prior GENED=minor, other=major working classification is retained and remains editable. Room-type and meeting-pattern simplifications are retained. These are application defaults, not newly extracted source fields.
The source dates 2026-08-03 to 2026-12-18 and source label 2nd Semester are retained exactly, even though they may need review.

Subject allowed weekdays and Saturday-only restrictions are preserved. Source weekdays_saturday is interpreted as weekdays with optional Saturday fallback. Sunday examples are not inferred from subject names.

All 23 existing curriculum choices and 373 subject/year memberships are retained; no additional curriculum containers can be created from the app. Existing memberships can be edited by department/program/year. Unmapped subjects remain Unassigned.
Production accounts, passwords, emails, employee numbers, sessions, approvals, live schedules and audits are not imported. Existing local user data is preserved when upgrading.
Lunch controls, consecutive limits, maximum contact minutes and any metadata without a direct source equivalent retain editable application defaults; no missing assignment is invented.
